build_contrastive_triplet_loss: build a ContrastiveTripletLoss to compute contrastive triplet loss from logits with configurable tau and normalization
build_kld_triplet_loss: build a KLDTripletLoss to compute KL divergence loss between predicted and target similarity distributions
build_jsd_triplet_loss: build a JSDTripletLoss to compute Jensen-Shannon divergence loss between predicted and target similarity distributions
review_dot_products: review the _dot_products function that calculates inner products between all pairs of triplet embeddings
